# A dependency that predates modules carries no go.mod, so its package is
# outside any main module until the go command gives it one. Its directives
# still run, and the tree they write carries no go.mod the module did not.
#
# The module cache sits inside the consumer's own module here, so the nearest
# go.mod above the dependency is the consumer's and not the dependency's.

env GOFLAGS=-mod=mod
env GOMODCACHE=$WORK/gopath/src/modcache

go mod download example.com/generatednomod
exists $GOMODCACHE/example.com/generatednomod@v1.0.0/lang/lang.gen.go

# The go.mod the generators needed was the stage's, and the completed module
# carries only what the zip carried plus what they added.
! exists $GOMODCACHE/example.com/generatednomod@v1.0.0/go.mod

go build .
! stderr 'outside main module'
! stderr 'go.mod file not found'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/consumer

go 1.16

require example.com/generatednomod v1.0.0
-- use.go --
package use

import "example.com/generatednomod/lang"

var Name = lang.Name()
